title: AI Riso Print
description: Transforms the photo into a handcrafted risograph print illustration.
positive_prompt: Transform the input photo into a handcrafted risograph print illustration. Reinterpret the complete image using a limited palette of 2 to 4 vibrant spot inks, such as coral red, teal, cobalt blue, mustard yellow, or fluorescent pink, printed on warm off-white paper. Apply authentic risograph grain, halftone dot patterns, subtle ink overlap, soft registration offsets, imperfect ink coverage, and tactile paper texture. Use simplified but expressive shapes, bold graphic contrast, and layered color separation reminiscent of independent art zines and vintage poster printing. Rendering contract: Use the input image as visual ground truth. Keep the exact number of subjects and their left-to-right order, relative scale, pose, gaze, interaction, and key props. For every visible person, retain recognizable face geometry, distinguishing facial characteristics, age range, hairstyles, expressions, poses, clothing shapes, composition, viewpoint, and important background elements in a style-appropriate form; do not beautify, age, or swap identity unless explicitly requested. Translate source colors into the restricted ink palette while maintaining clear visual distinctions and approximate tonal relationships. Registration imperfections must remain subtle and must not displace facial features or distort anatomy. Preserve the source aspect ratio, camera viewpoint, and all important content inside the frame. Apply the transformation consistently across the entire scene to subjects, clothing, props, and environment. Return one coherent finished image, not a before-and-after comparison, split screen, or unintended collage. Output one finished static print without added typography, letters, numerals, logos, signatures, watermarks, or decorative frames.
negative_prompt: photorealism, glossy digital gradients, smooth airbrushed finish, 3D rendering, metallic surfaces, perfect digital printing, excessive ink misregistration, severe color bleeding, muddy colors, washed-out image, unreadable faces, altered identity, incorrect anatomy, missing people, extra subjects, distorted hands, duplicated features, inconsistent color separation, text, logos, watermarks, collage, split screen, identity drift, face swap, altered age, altered skin tone, wrong subject count, extra people, duplicated subject, merged subjects, inconsistent transformation, partial transformation, before-and-after, unintended collage, accidental crop, cut-off face, broken hands, fused fingers, extra limbs, incoherent perspective, floating objects, random text, gibberish letters, numerals, signature, interface elements
